about_the_game:
Dive deeper into the world of Terminus: Zombie Survivors with the original soundtrack, crafted by award-winning composer Emmett Cooke and Reuben Cornell.

This album includes 21 tracks that capture the suspenseful and eerie atmosphere of a post-apocalyptic world, delivering over an hour and a half of music. It’s designed to enhance your experience of the game’s dramatic and immersive world, available to enjoy whenever you wish to revisit the haunting vibe of Terminus: Zombie Survivors.

The soundtrack is available in MP3 and FLAC lossless formats.
